scenes.say: We're moving our premium reminders to WhatsApp. Friendly, personal, and sent from the branch's own number.
Every morning at nine, the premium due report lands. It's the first thing you open.
Then comes your check. Filter your agents' clients by band, tick every box on the checklist, and mark whether the agent is active, or has left us.
There are five bands. From forty five days overdue, all the way to a policy that lapsed today. Each band has its own message.
This is what your client sees. A warm hello from the branch, the last four digits of their policy, and three easy buttons.
When they tap, it becomes a ticket with a reference number. It goes to the staff owner, with a target time to answer.
At four o'clock, Kamla reviews the board. How many went out, who tapped, what's still open, and what's past its time.
Your name is on every tick. If it isn't verified, it doesn't go.
This isn't only about premiums. It's about showing every client that their branch is looking out for them.
